items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Jonah played with me in the Big Band.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Was Jonah Jones in with you at any point in there?
Yes, but Jonah played with the Big Band.

items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Went to work with Benny Carter. There was Pop Smith, Bobby Williams and myself.

ctx.x: So then I'd give a man his check and Stuff would say, "Now, who's running the band, me?" I said, "Well, you said it was all right, you know, because I'm not going to stay here while you buy automobiles and things, you know. I can't afford this, Stuff." "And the other guys feel the same way. They'll tell you." And see, he probably wanted to do something with the money then, and he couldn't get his hands

on it, you know. So then he went back to Buffalo, so that was all. We finished at Blatt's Beer Garden. That was it. And that's when I come into New York and we waited around. I went down to the booking office, and they said, "Well, it looks like he's going to stay there, because he'll get himself in trouble if he ever comes here to work, because he's got a contract with us." I said, well, I don't have time to wait for him, you know. So they said, "Well, Jonah, what are you going to do?" So I said, "I'm going to…
Left Benny and went into Roseland with Fletcher.
